details.jobDescription:
Ideal Candidate

Good communication, negotiation, and planning skills.
Analytic and focused on details.
Good level of English language.
Advanced PC skills: MS Office, SAP would be an advantage;

Bachelor’s Degree in Economics or Technical field

Fixed-term contract of 2 years for maternity

Main Tasks:
Prepares and launches the raw materials & packaging orders according to the production demand.
Maintains the relationship with the suppliers to ensure the on-time delivery.
Follows the transportation and materials delivery.
Analysing raw material and packaging fluctuation and keeping record of delivery plans from suppliers.
Follows up and respects the daily routine procedure, aiming at eliminating the risks of stopping production due lack of raw materials and components.
Planning according to demands and managing technical changes & EOP, without obsolete.
Continuously monitors the materials and components stock, maintaining it at the minimum agreed level.
Maintains and updates the system parameters (Material Master Data) for all the components/materials in his/her area of responsibility.
Coordination, implementation, and verification of packaging requirements (i.e. customer and supplier requirements, pallets, labelling, stability, filling capacity, technical standards).
Responsible for calculating and providing logistics costs for new RFQ for both, customer projects and suppliers (Newtron portal).
Manage different customer’s and supplier`s portals for container management, inventory reconciliations.
Sets the delivery frequency with suppliers, launch new suppliers according to logistics contract.
Performs supplier evaluation and recommends improvement if necessary.
Elaborates and prepares specific reports on a periodical basis and at request.Registers and updates logistics complaints to suppliers

Avantaje şi beneficii:
Pachet salarial competitiv;
Programe de dezvoltare personală & şcolarizare;
Reduceri costuri cantină; Tichete de masă;
Decontare costuri abonamente transport & combustibil pentru angajații navetişti;
Prime de compensare a ideilor de îmbunătăţire;
Reduceri sala fitness & centru de recreere.

Grupul Stabilus are sediul in Koblenz, Germania din 1934 si este cunoscut la nivel global pentru traditia in dezvoltarea produselor inovatoare ce isi propun sa aduca confort in tehnologii. Producem arcuri pe gaz, amortizoare de combatere a vibratiilor si actuatoare electromecanice ce sunt utilizate in multe sectoare industriale din lume: automotive, mobilier, servicii de constructii, produse tehnologice si echipamente de reabilitare medicala. Pe aceasta baza, Stabilus ofera angajatilor sai perspective interesante, conditii excelente de lucru si beneficii suplimentare si in Romania - unde compania se dezvolta de mai bine de 17 ani cu cele doua fabrici pe care le are in prezent: fabrica Gas Springs si fabrica Powerise - cu aproape 1400 de angajati. Sabilus - Your motion, our solution!

Daca doriti sa faceti parte din familia noastra, dar doriti alt rol - puteti aplica! Avem multe departamente care au nevoie de colegi cu experienta, poate esti ceea ce cautam! Departamente de - Cercetare Dezvoltare/ Inginerie - Echipamente și procese - Mentenanță - Calitate - Achiziții - Financiar și Contabilitate - Resurse Umane - Producție - Logistică - Optimizare și procese - Administrativ - SSM și mediu
